name: Sleep Vote
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: user128142
description: Skip the night democratically:  Sleep Vote replaces the vanilla sleep mechanic with a server-wide voting system. Right click a bed at night to start a vote, and if the majority agrees, the night is skipped for everyone.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-20 (eda5a4a5) (48 classes, 74 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
